releases.notes:
## **v3.8.0 — Restricted Access: Surgeon Edition**

### 🪪 Added — Identity & Access
- Added **Hospital ID Card system**
  - Added **Hospital ID Card** items with **three cosmetic variants**
  - All ID card variants are functionally identical
  - Variants exist for visual diversity only and do not affect gameplay
  - ID cards are used as access credentials for scanner blocks
- Added **ID Card Scanner** block
  - Right-click interaction only
  - Requires the player to be holding a valid Hospital ID Card
  - Emits a short redstone pulse when activated (button-like behavior)
  - Automatically resets after a short delay
  - Provides feedback when an invalid item is scanned
  - No GUI, no inventory, no stored state
  - Designed for simple access control use cases (doors, redstone systems)

---

### 🏷️ Added — Wearables
- Added **Patient Wristband**
  - Wearable in the **offhand**
  - Uses a custom 3D model
  - Visible in third-person view
  - Does not obstruct first-person view
  - Non-placeable
  - Intended as a visual indicator of patient identity
  - Does not provide gameplay effects

---

### 🛠️ Added — Surgical & Medical Tools
- Added **Scalpel**
  - Configured as a high-damage melee tool
  - Very slow attack speed
  - Intended to represent precision rather than sustained combat
- Added **Forceps** *(visual-only)*
- Added **Surgical Scissors** *(visual-only)*
- Added **Retractors** *(visual-only)*
- Added **Surgical Marker** *(visual-only)*
- Added **Percussion Hammer** *(visual-only)*
- Added **Tourniquet** *(visual-only)*

---

### 🧾 Crafting
- Added crafting recipes for all new items and blocks
- ID card variants are crafted using distinct ingredient combinations
- All ID card variants share the same functionality and access permissions

---

### ⚙️ Technical Notes
- ID card validity is handled using item tags to allow future expansion
- Scanner logic is intentionally stateless and localized to nearby interactions
- All visual-only items are cosmetic and do not introduce new mechanics
- No new decorative blocks or crafting systems were introduced in this update

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DerpyMeow/Hospitals/compare/3.7.0...3.8.0

releases.notes:
## 🏥 Hospitals Mod — v3.6.0

This update completes the **core blood mechanics system**, transitions the mod out of its experimental phase, and introduces guided in-game documentation so players can actually understand and use the systems added so far.

---

### 🩸 Blood Mechanics (Core Feature Completion)

- Implemented **blood transfusion mechanics** with real compatibility logic:
  - **Matched blood** provides strong healing and buffs
  - **Compatible blood** provides moderate healing
  - **Incompatible blood** causes damage and negative effects
- Added **IV Kit**:
  - Uses blood bags automatically based on best available match
  - Has durability (20 uses)
  - Consumes blood bags and returns **Used Blood Bags** (medical waste)
- Blood bags can only be used when the player is **below max health** (accounts for health boost)
- Fully implemented **donor compatibility logic** (ABO + Rh)
- Added **Used Blood Bag** item (non-reusable)

---

### 🧪 Machines & Processing

- Added **Centrifuge**:
  - Converts **4 blood syringes → 1 blood bag**
  - Converts **blood bags → syringes**
  - Dedicated GUI with locked output slots
- Added **Purifier recipes** (logic completed previously, now integrated)
- Added crafting recipes for:
  - Centrifuge
  - Purifier

---

### 📘 In-Game Documentation (NEW)

Added two craftable in-game textbooks to explain mechanics without requiring an external wiki:

- **Blood Transfusions: A Beginner’s Guide**
  - Explains blood types, compatibility, and transfusion outcomes
- **Chemistry 101**
  - Explains the Purifier and Centrifuge machines

Crafting:
- Blood book → `Book + Crimson Fungus`
- Chemistry book → `Book + Redstone Torch`

---

### 🎨 Content & UX Improvements

- Removed the **“Experimental” creative tab** to reduce clutter
- Deleted the **Experimental Info Book**
- Moved **Surgical Mask** to the main Hospitals tab
- Added crafting recipe for Surgical Mask
- Removed warning text from Surgical Mask tooltip
- Added textures & models for:
  - Centrifuge
  - Purifier

---

### ⚙️ Technical & Project Changes

- Updated mod credits to reflect transition from a **mod port** to a **standalone mod**
- Cleaned up internal logic and GUI dependencies
- Stabilized systems for future UI and wiki overhaul in v4.0

---

### 🧭 Notes

- This update finalizes **blood mechanics** for the v3.x cycle
- Future updates (v4.0+) will focus on:
  - UI polish
  - Wiki overhaul
  - Expanded medical systems

---

releases.notes:
- Changed the default blood type from O- to random
--- On the first world join, Players will be given a blood type
- Blood type tester item 
--- Survival alternative to /blood type get [name]
--- Added crafting recipe
- Empty syringes can draw blood
--- Draw from self (gives a filled syringe of your type)
--- Draw from another player (gives a filled syringe of their type)
--- Draw from other mob (gives a filled syringe of mixed blood)
--- Costs the entity or player 1 hp (half a heart)
--- No implemented use for typed syringes YET
- Purifier Machine
--- Takes two mixed syringes, outputs two typed syringes
--- Takes mixed blood bucket and empty blood bag, outputs random blood bag, and empty bucket
- Empty Blood Bags Craftable
- Empty Syringes Craftable
- Moved "Warning Block" from "Experimental" creative tab to "Hospitals".
